responsibility: Declares the jump-threading engine interfaces and path-state abstractions for tree SSA CFG threading. It defines jt_state and jt_simplifier callback classes, hybrid ranger-based simplifier/state variants, the jump_threader class for discovering and registering threadable paths, and shared SSA_NAME value-tracking hooks used while simplifying control statements across candidate threading paths.
same_name_distinction: This header provides the class/interface layer for jump-thread discovery—jt_state, jt_simplifier, hybrid variants, jump_threader, and SSA_NAME value-tracking declarations. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-threadedge.cc, it does not perform the actual path simplification or candidate-thread discovery work.
